Notwithstanding any other provision of law to the 12 contrary, an authorized noninstitutional investor of a business 13 engaged in the manufacturing, importing, bottling, selling at 14 wholesale, or selling at retail of alcoholic beverages may 15 directly or indirectly have an ownership interest in another 16 licensee or permittee authorized under this chapter to sell 17 at retail alcoholic beverages, if the person remains only 18 an authorized noninstitutional investor of the licensee or 19 permittee authorized under this chapter to sell at retail 20 alcoholic beverages. 21 2. Any authorized noninstitutional investor of a business 22 engaged in the manufacturing, importing, bottling, or selling 23 at wholesale of alcoholic beverages that is also an authorized 24 noninstitutional investor of another business holding a retail 25 alcohol license issued under this chapter shall annually 26 disclose the ownership interest to the department in a manner 27 prescribed by the director.
